title: Os8088.com: IBM XT OS now has a Browser, CP/M 2.2 with Z80 core and MS Word 1.1a
summary: A browser-based emulator project that recreates the IBM XT computing environment, supporting not only the original 8088-based DOS system but also CP/M 2.2 with Z80 emulation and legacy MS Word 1.1a, allowing users to experience vintage computing directly in modern browsers.
problem_solved: Enables preservation and accessibility of historical computing systems by running 40-year-old software like IBM XT OS, CP/M, and MS Word in modern browsers without native hardware.
why_valuable: It serves as both a digital museum for computing history and a technical demonstration of browser-based hardware emulation, making retro computing accessible to enthusiasts and educators.
